hints.title: Leading Ones Invariance
hints.text: Any prefix consisting entirely of ones is already optimal and should never be altered.

hints.title: Shift Zeros Together
hints.text: The operation 10 to 01 allows shifting any zero to the left past adjacent ones.

hints.title: Collapse Adjacent Zeros
hints.text: Repeatedly applying 00 to 10 turns k contiguous zeros into k - 1 ones followed by a single zero.

hints.title: Full Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def maximumBinaryString(self, s: str) -> str:
        if '0' not in s:
            return s
        first_zero = s.find('0')
        zeros = s.count('0')
        ones_before = first_zero
        ones_between = zeros - 1
        ones_after = len(s) - ones_before - zeros
        return '1' * (ones_before + ones_between) + '0' + '1' * ones_after
```

variables: n is length of binary string
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Graph search or backtracking over all possible replacement paths takes exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Counting leading ones and zeros reconstructs the optimal string directly in O(n) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate explains invariant that all zeros except one can always be transformed into ones.
